svg.title: cross-port-kill: pk localhost:3000
svg.desc: A terminal frees ports written in different ways, as pasted from an error message or a browser. pk localhost:3000 frees node on 3000. pk http://localhost:5173/ frees the vite server. pk :::8000, the address from an EADDRINUSE error, frees python3 on 8000. pk udp:5353 frees UDP port 5353. pk --forse 9000 is a typo and pk answers: Did you mean '--force'?
